name: agent-phonon HITL Bridge
description: Intercepts tool calls and routes them to agent-phonon for human-in-the-loop approval.

interceptTools.description: Tool names to intercept (empty = intercept all)

bridgeToken.description: Bearer token for the legacy HITL bridge; not a native turn capability

nativeInteractions.description: Explicitly enable turn-scoped Phonon human-input, board and workflow tools, and admin-only binding RPCs

peerContext.description: Enable private current-run collaboration checkpoints and coordination-only tools for qualified native OpenClaw runtimes; receive also requires explicit prompt-injection and conversation-access hook grants, and tools retain native policy
